overview: Ellie Lust and her team confront fraudsters who have not only broken the hearts of their loved ones, but also left them penniless. The police and judicial authorities can do little or nothing about this devious behavior, because in most cases no criminal offense has been committed.
title: Opgelicht In De Liefde?

overview: Ellie Lust and cyberjournalist Daniël Verlaan delve into the dark world of online scams. How are people hacked, scammed, and even exposed online when their most personal information is made public? Ellie highlights urgent issues and the stories of victims, while Daniël and his team of ethical hackers thoroughly investigate the scams.
title: Scam Alert: Trap Er Niet In!

overview: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones host an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.
title: TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle

overview: SMart was a British CBBC television programme based on the subject of art, which began in 1994 and ended in 2009. The programme was recorded at BBC Television Centre in London, previously it had been recorded in Studio A at BBC Pebble Mill in Birmingham. The format is similar to the Tony Hart programmes Take Hart and Hartbeat. The show was revamped into an hour-long show in 2007; it was previously a 25-minute show. The 'older' 25 minute shows from 1994–2005 (it didn't appear in the 2006 series) also featured Morph, originally from Take Hart. It has 199 episodes. CBBC last aired SMart on 11 August 2011.
title: SMart

overview: Hidden in the heart of Berlin, ex-spies Simon and Meret run a safe house. When a threat they thought was buried reappears, they find themselves hiding from assassins, Russian agents, the BND, ex-lovers and a whole bunch of people they have wronged - all while trying to keep their marriage together.
title: Unfamiliar

overview: Maxxed Out reveals how money (and mismanaged money) can strain even the strongest relationships. Each episode uncovers the "What were you thinking?" moments behind financial disasters and the tough love it takes to turn things around.
title: Maxxed Out

overview: Two of 5's much-loved faces team up to focus on the issues that matter most to viewers - with your opinions front and centre.
title: Storm & Alexis

overview: Matt looks at the big news stories developing during the day and offers help and advice to save you money and make your lives a little easier.
title: Matt Allwright

overview: Photsawat is a former famous boxing champion who was forced to leave the sport after being accused of throwing a match and, to make matters worse, his ex-wife ran off with all his hard-earned savings. Now living hand to mouth, he works as a motorcycle taxi driver to support his daughter. By chance, he meets Homerun, a young man who once suffered from depression because of his difficult past. Inspired by Photsawat, Homerun manages to turn his life around and make a fresh start. He asks Photsawat to become his boxing coach so that he can pursue his dream of becoming a champion. However, his true goal is not only to win in the ring, but also to win his coach's heart.
title: How I Got My Trainer to be My Boyfriend

overview: When luxury-loving Nordin Kynani is forced by his mother to spend a year teaching at an underprivileged school, he expects an easy ride. But between rebellious students, a corrupt principal, and his own ego, he soon learns that real life isn't about fast cars, but about making an impact. Can he turn himself and his class into a success story, or will he fail spectacularly?
title: Nordin

overview: NASCAR 120 is a two-hour condensed version of the latest NASCAR race.
title: NASCAR 120

overview: Assassinations, even of the most treacherous dictator, can shake a nation's confidence, launch wars, or end them. Now, we go behind closed doors to meet the rebels, revolutionaries, and intelligence operatives tasked with these takedowns.
title: To Kill a Dictator

overview: Martin Sleipnes, Morten Ramm og Vegar Tryggeseid reiser rundt for å gi folk en drømmedag av dimensjoner.
title: Drömdag

overview: The very first behind-the-scenes look at the newly, but upcoming K-POP Group BABYMONSTER that shows their everyday life, providing a warm and lively glimpse into their home and personalities.
title: Baemon House

overview: Targeting a priceless work of art, Berlin assembles his gang of thieves in Seville in this explosive new installment from the creators of Money Heist.
title: Berlín y la dama del armiño

overview: The series follows the three Russo sisters, heirs to a struggling figure skating dynasty. As middle sister, seventeen-year-old Adriana trains for the World Championships with new partner Brayden, while still harbouring feelings for her first love and former partner, Freddie. Her life becomes complicated when she and Brayden pretend to be a couple off the ice so they can land a sponsorship to keep the financially struggling Russo rink afloat.
title: Finding Her Edge

overview: Seven ambitious and extraordinary women open their lives and businesses to reveal what it really takes to build empires, balance family, and navigate friendship at the highest level-where each and every move is personal, powerful, and under the spotlight.
title: The CEO Club

overview: In 1995, after returning to his hometown, Zhao Fengsheng is shunned by old neighbors over a misunderstanding. To clear his name, he leads the "Four Troublemakers of Old Street" to dismantle a sinister conspiracy, resolve old grudges, and ultimately protect the peace of his homeland.
title: Old Street Justice

overview: Comedy series following regular and first-time holidaymakers as they visit the Solana Resort in Benidorm. All the guests have one thing in common: a quest to get value for their hard-earned Euros.
title: Benidorm

overview: The ScentBlocker Most Wanted team is made up of veteran outdoor hosts Larry Woodward and Bob Richardson. Both these guys have been producing and hosting shows like Outdoors in the Heartland from Heartland Productions.
title: ScentBlocker Most Wanted

overview: Medical student Jiang Yuanyue, in search of her missing elder sister Jiang Shuwan, assumes the alias Yan Ran and deliberately approaches Zeng Yuankai, the second young master of the Zeng family. Successfully infiltrating the household by posing as Yuankai's maid, Yan Ran continues her investigation and ultimately discovers her sister's body buried in the abandoned courtyard of the Zeng estate. She comes to suspect that the culprits may be the two Zeng brothers. Following the mysterious death of Chen Shulin, Yan Ran and Zeng Yuankai gradually uncover the true, ruthless nature of the Zeng family patriarch Zeng Shaozong. They expose his past crimes, including the deaths of Jiang Yunwen and Gu Manqing, Zeng Yuankai's biological mother, and the devastating truth that Zeng Shaozong is not Yuankai's real father.
title: Her Radiance

overview: Jiang Li, daughter of the Grand Tutor, often retreats to the secluded Wenxiang Pavilion with her confidante, A Zhao, to avoid an arranged marriage. Forced into a marriage with the Left General, she enters the palace, only to discover that A Zhao is the reigning emperor. From then on, they are deeply entangled in love and palace secrets.
title: Elegy of ZhaoLi

overview: Rebelling against her father's arranged marriage, independent woman Aurel gets drunk and mistakes the billionaire Ray for a male escort, claiming to want to pay for his services. When she finds out he is her childhood sweetheart, the line between truth and falsehood is blurred. Their relationship arouses suspicion within Aurel's family, setting the stage for a family feud...
title: Romance in the Lie
Lao Zu De Lao Gong Jing Shi Xiao Jiao Fu

overview: National Geographic announced today the greenlight of Best of the World with Antoni Porowski, a vibrant new travel docuseries set to premiere in 2026 on National Geographic, Disney+ and Hulu. Inspired by National Geographic's annual Best of the World list of travel recommendations and bestselling book, the four-part series follows Emmy®-winner and New York Times bestselling author Antoni Porowski on a deeply personal journey through Paris, Mexico City, London and New York City. Bringing his signature curiosity, humor and refined taste, Porowski takes the Best of the World list one step further to explore food, places to stay, wellness and hidden corners of each city. He plunges into unforgettable moments: learning the delicate precision of Paris' most hyper-local and inventive Michelin-starred restaurant, paddling through centuries-old canals in Mexico City, and connecting with locals whose stories define what makes each city truly shine. Using National Geographic's signature cinematography and storytelling expertise, the series brings each city to life with the authenticity and visual richness the brand is known for. Each episode presents a mosaic of accessible yet aspirational moments that reflect the diversity, creativity, and emerging trends shaping each city today.
title: Best of the World with Antoni Porowski

overview: Join Team Magnum's Tim Herald, James Brion, Gary Joseph and Rob Dunham as we travel the world searching for the biggest and most majestic game on the planet. "Magnum TV" presented by Western Powders delivers hunts with sophisticated, award winning videography. Follow our team of professional hunters and Magnum Hunt Club members from the wind-blown plains of Nebraska to the wild plains of Africa. Every week is a true hunting adventure in High Definition.
title: Magnum TV

overview: Vince arrives on Terschelling with his daughter Zoë for what seems like an innocent father-daughter vacation. The summer that was supposed to bring them closer takes a different turn on Terschelling. Behind his smile lies a secret: he's come to Terschelling with a mission.
title: Badgast

overview: In this reality TV show with the feel of a Christmas tale, Katherine Levac gives a charming single woman 24 days to find love.
title: Le calendrier de l'avent

overview: Suddenly Amish follows six non-Amish individuals on a rare journey as they leave behind their modern "English" lifestyle and step into a deeply traditional Amish community in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. Seeking a profound change from their present way of modern life, each participant contemplates the possibility of converting into Amish society, as they navigate drastically different routines and a culture defined by faith, discipline, simplicity and community.
title: Suddenly Amish

overview: A wonderful family tale that encompasses both joyous and sorrowful moments, intertwining the past and present, while also delving into the realms of mystery and truth.
title: Buongiorno, Mamma!

overview: When Emma Parker turns 18, she learns that Logan Carter, the alpha of her pack, is her future mate. But her happiness is short-lived when Logan rejects her for another she-wolf.
title: True Luna
Omer et le Fils de l'Etoile

overview: A bloody confrontation takes place between villains over super-notes, which is a counterfeit bill of extreme high quality.
title: Villains

overview: The Assassination Attempt is a German two-part television film by Miguel Alexandre from 2018. Petra Schmidt-Schaller and Ulrich Tukur can be seen in the leading roles. The political thriller is based on real events around the RAF murders of Alfred Herrhausen and Detlev Rohwedder as well as the events in Bad Kleinen and is based on the novel The Last Terrorist by André Georgi.
title: Der Mordanschlag

overview: Skinny Dip is the story of Joey Perrone, whose second anniversary didn't go quite as planned. She expected earrings, but instead, her husband Chaz had, shall we say, alternate plans. After unexpectedly finding herself on the other side of those plans, she vows to get revenge. Teaming up with a disgraced ex-cop, Joey sets out to make Chaz pay. Skinny Dip is an action-romantic-comedy-triangle about murder, vengeance, and the elusiveness of true accountability in this world.
title: Skinny Dip

overview: Years after their acrimonious divorce, an ex-couple learns that the cryptocurrency they won on a crazy night on a cruise is now worth millions… but they've forgotten the password. With only three days left before the account expires, they must retrace their steps that night, not just to find the password to their fortune, but also why they fell in love in the first place.
title: One Attempt Remaining

overview: Three hundred years ago, the Celestial Maiden Jin Li sealed away the Demon Lord Jie Chuan. Three centuries later, a young celestial beast, Jinli, accidentally breaks the seal. Drawn into the demon realm for her ability to absorb his magic, they are locked in a cycle of conflict and attraction. But when the truth emerges—that Jinli carries the fragmented soul of Celestial Maiden Jin Li—their fragile bond is tested by love, betrayal, and the echoes of an ancient feud.
title: A Vow in the Dark

overview: A Bird That Doesn't Cry is a melodrama centered on Oh Ha-nui, a woman whose life collapses after she becomes entangled in a high-stakes insurance murder case. What begins as a sudden family tragedy grows into a destructive chain of lies, greed, and betrayal. As Ha-nui loses the stability and relationships she once relied on, she discovers that a woman named Chun Mi-ja stands at the heart of the events that ruined her life. Determined not to remain a victim, Ha-nui sets out to uncover the truth behind the crime and confront the people who exploited her pain for their own gain. The story follows her journey through revenge, complicated loyalties, and the emotional cost of pursuing justice in a world where everyone has something to hide.
title: Bird That Doesn't Cry

overview: Angela is a social worker, an active, empathetic woman with a sunny character. But a few months ago she lost her nine-year-old son Matteo in a car accident. A tragedy that broke her. In an attempt to rediscover the meaning of her existence, she returns to her family home, in a small village on an island in the Tuscan archipelago, where she was born. But even here the memories of her torment her.
title: Come una madre

overview: Sabrina, an investigative journalist, leads a stable life with her daughter and husband. However, her world collapses with the reappearance of Salvador Carvallo, a famous artist and friend of her mother Iris, who reopens dark chapters in Sabrina's life that she thought were forgotten and threatens her stability.
title: Camaleón: El pasado no cambia

overview: Four young mothers strengthen their friendship beyond their children's school chat group after an intense school camping trip, where they discover who is having an affair with one of their husbands.
title: Valiendo Madres

overview: In five days the whole world will know that Jacob Widman is this year's Nobel price in economics. There's just one problem. He is dead. Jacob's best friends then decide to let those around them believe he's alive until the big day, but it soon turns out that each also has their own motives bubbling to the surface.
title: Äntligen!

overview: This dark crime thriller follows Detective Aina Anglada as she begrudgingly works with her new partner, Damia, to find a serial killer before it's too late - following a grisly trail of body parts from the disturbed killer. Meanwhile, within their special police unit, trust is in short supply and the detectives, their commander, and others struggle to work together.
title: Treufoc

overview: Antonio Albanese creates his first TV series for Rai, featuring Sebastiano, a mafia fugitive hiding in a villa in northern Italy, equipped with clever hiding spots. His existence, like that of real mafia fugitives, remains invisible to the police. Sebastiano relies on his trusted man U Stuortu, his wife Betta, daughter Carmen, who often clashes with him, and his son Benni, passionate about molecular cuisine. The family also includes his gambling aunt Vincenza and mafia boss uncle Vincenzo, who has been self-imprisoned in a basement for twelve years.
title: I Topi

overview: Drama about child welfare workers and the effects of their work on the lives of these workers. Rita returns to her job in child protection after being furloughed during a police investigation. The child is still missing, and Rita is held responsible for the situation. She was replaced as manager by a new director, Jyrki. When she returns to work, Rita is paired with the inexperienced Laura. Together, Rita and Laura become an effective team but the boundaries between their work and private life begin to blur.
title: Pala sydämestä

overview: An investigative journalist at a newspaper must save her uncertain career as she struggles with financial and personal issues.
title: Pressa

overview: Maria returns to her hometown in Puglia hoping to spend more time with her teen daughter and young son. The family is immediately swept into conflicts between a criminal family (the Patriarcas) and "Neverland," led by mysterious Annagreca.
title: Il Capitano Maria

overview: The occasion is sad, as Wolff-Dieter Meurer recently died. He was popular in the town of Lassahn in Mecklenburg-West Pomerania, in complete contrast to his wife Gaby Krolmann-Meurer. Now his four children have come to the funeral. While Sabine Stenz-Meurer, Thorsten, Mario and Kevin and other guests at the funeral talk about their father's memory, old stories soon surface that show the past in a new light. When inheritance disputes begin to boil over, devotion is over.
title: Das Begräbnis

overview: Ana is a 16 year-old, daughter of divorced parents, who are changing schools after being expelled from prior for attacking a colleague. His intelligence and his peculiar behavior to make be quite lonely.Until she meets Alex, a 18 year old who loves to test the social rules and question the world. Together, they decide to go beyond, to resolve play a joke on the teacher of Literature and Spanish, Tristán.
title: A Menina Sem Qualidades

overview: Bandit groups take over entire cities in post-war Russia. Rostov-on-Don is no exception. In 1947, a gang appears there that robs the city at night. Egor Dragun, a criminal investigation officer, suspects that the gang is not made up of ordinary criminals. As a result of the investigation, it turns out that the robbery of the city is just a cover. The main goal of the gang is to free a German scientist who is working on creating a nuclear bomb. Now Egor has to stop a new war.
title: Чёрные кошки

overview: A series of five episodes set in the same hotel room. Five different stories, five different genres and Marcelina, the charming yet incompetent hotel cleaner.
title: 4 Mure

overview: This unique documentary series sheds light on eight of Sweden's queens. Each episode is dedicated to one of our queens and her fascinating life story, from childhood to the last breath - always one step behind her king, but with great power to influence both politically and culturally. The series is based on real events from Swedish history from the 16th century until the 1930s that have never been told in a format like this before. The reconstructions take place at castles and manors around Sweden, including Stockholm Castle, Rosersberg Castle and Gripsholm Castle. Many times in the same place as the real event took place. In addition, environments have been created that will take place in Germany, France, Italy, Switzerland, Egypt, and the Netherlands.
title: Drottningarna

overview: TV series that adapts the famous novel by Vicente Blasco Ibanez. In a village on the Albufera valenciana in an atmosphere of fishermen and rice, three generations of the family "the Dove" together in the place: the grandfather, the best fisherman on the lake, Hue, the son, who has devoted his life to gain ground water in an endless task, carrying earth to get his boat, inch by inch, to be able to cultivate a field, finally Tonet, the grandson, the black sheep of the family, which, by their conduct, cause disgrace of all. As a background of family life is the Spain of the late nineteenth and early twentieth century, an era full social transformation.
title: Cañas y Barro

overview: Madame Jacqueline Requin, widow, banker, economics expert, who presides over a financial group that makes up the bank she inherited from her husband, who recently died in a dubious accident. The bank is in imminent danger of bankruptcy. On a whirlwind eight-day trip to Buenos Aires, Jacqueline will try to carry out a mega political-financial scam that will allow her to obtain the funds to rescue her bank. This will generate a network of corruption that, as collateral damage, will irreparably harm her only emotional refuge: his daughter and granddaughter
title: Madame Requin

overview: Vera Zhuravleva was an athlete and professionally engaged in wrestling. After a severe injury, her life changed dramatically. She got a job as a truck driver and moved in with her childhood friend Igor, whom she is going to marry without much love. An injury sustained during the competition made it impossible for her ever to become pregnant. In this regard, Igor's mother is unhappy with her son's choice. By coincidence, the widower Leonid, who has two children, appears in Vera's life. And the unexpected happens - unexpectedly, the youngest daughter of Leonid Marishka calls Vera her mother.
title: Доченьки

overview: Former police psychiatrist Kira Ustyanova gets a job in an elite private clinic, which, in circumstances of the strictest secrecy, treats wealthy clients for neuroses and eating disorders. Two teenage girls are taken to the clinic - presumably after a suicide attempt. Their father, a wealthy businessman, died the day before under mysterious circumstances, their mother disappeared a few years before. The case is being handled by Kira's husband, who recently became an ex.
title: Тихие воды

overview: Inspired by his late mentor to explore life's big questions, Will throws himself into incredible challenges for 100 days: skiing to the South Pole, catching a giant anaconda, milking a venomous tarantula, climbing mountains, and diving under the ice of the North Pole. He will venture from pole to pole in the company of scientists, explorers and local experts. Told with a cinematic scale, access, and authenticity only National Geographic can deliver, this once-in-a-lifetime adventure blends cutting-edge science, environmental storytelling, and bold exploration. Guided by experts, scientists and explorers, Will helps make world-first scientific discoveries and forges profound human connections — from the Amazon's Waorani community to the Kalahari's San people,whose knowledge and resilience offer powerful lessons about our future on the planet. Pole to Pole with Will Smith is an epic global undertaking defined by endurance, wonder and hope.
title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith

overview: Three boys embark on a volleyball journey that will challenge far more than their athletic skills. As members of the "Green Goats," they must overcome formidable trials both on and off the court.
title: Tropang G.O.A.T.

overview: Tata, a simple, poor and jolly Ilongga girl experiences a life-altering event when people realize she is the doppelganger of the rich and famous Venice, a social media influencer and actress from Iloilo. When Venice escapes the country and abandons everything, her husband, Francis, will convince Tata to take her place while they look for her. However, Tata's impersonation of Venice soon takes a complicated turn when she falls in love with Francis and his family.
title: My Ilonggo Girl

overview: The story will revolve around the lives of best friends Sam and George, who treat each other as sisters, but later on, their friendship will be ruined and they will find love. Unbeknownst to the two, they are marrying two men who belong to the same family, the Palacios.
title: Widows' War

overview: Home & Family - Home for the Holidays is an annual special event with holiday music, Christmas light displays and many special guests.
title: Home & Family - Home for the Holidays

overview: A top scholar uncovers how the school profits from students and fights back—turning cheat sheets into a money-making scheme.
title: Bad Genius: The Series

overview: Set a decade after the U.S.S Voyager's return to Earth, a rag-tag crew of renegades and outcasts must covertly work with Admiral Chekov and Tuvok to stop forces threatening the Federation from outside, and within.
title: Star Trek: Renegades

overview: He is the superstar. She is "only" his sister, "Nannerl," even though she, like her brother, possesses exceptional musical talent. However, when Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart suffers a setback and can no longer perform, the family's financial future is suddenly at stake—and with it, Maria Anna's personal freedom. To save Amadeus's career and herself, Maria Anna is forced to step into her brother's shoes. Soon, she finds herself caught in a web of royal intrigue, at the center of which is none other than the man who has fallen head over heels in love with her: Antonio Salieri.
title: Mozart/Mozart

overview: From Indy to Nashville, the fight for the championship heats up. Go behind the scenes for raw emotion, fierce battles, and every critical turn in America's premier open-wheel racing series.
title: Road to the IndyCar Championship

overview: MS NOW's Ali Velshi and Stephanie Ruhle answer your questions LIVE and take an in-depth look at the biggest stories at the intersection of business, politics and the economy.
title: It's Happening with Velshi & Ruhle

overview: Set in the late 1980s, school is out for the summer and a sun-drenched season of firsts beckons the counselors at Camp Stillwater, a seemingly idyllic Midwestern summer camp, including first loves, first kisses - and first kills. Stillwater's dark, ancient mythology awakens, and what was supposed to be a summer of fun soon turns into one of unforgettable scares and evil at every turn.
title: Dead of Summer

overview: A robbery attempt at a small corner store ends fatally. A seven-year-old boy disappears and an envelope with a lot of money changes hands. The lives of people who have never had anything to do with each other collide violently.
title: Der Überfall

overview: When friends with benefits, Nanna and Lasse, decide to take their relationship to the next level, Nanna quickly gets pregnant. But there is something, that Nanna hasn't told Lasse. Can their relationship survive those kinds of secrets?
title: Ingen vej tilbage

overview: Reiji Doki, an investigator for the Galaxy Federal Police, is Gavan Infinity, the only person in the universe permitted to claim the title of "Space Sheriff Gavan". However, he is stationed in the backwater Archives Department. His true objective is to investigate Emorgy crimes across dimensions.
title: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity
